knock.text: Three firm knocks on a heavy wooden hotel room door in a quiet corridor at night, close, dry, no music, no voices

door-open.text: An old heavy wooden hotel room door opening slowly with a soft creak, interior, close, no music, no voices

door-close.text: A heavy wooden hotel room door closing gently, ending with a soft latch click, interior, close, no music

growl.text: A large dog growling low and quiet from deep in its chest, steady and menacing, close microphone, no barking, no music

snow-steps.text: Two people walking slowly side by side over fresh snow at night in a quiet, empty old-town street, soft crunching footsteps, no voices, no traffic, no music

pummerin.text: A single toll of an enormous, very deep cathedral bell heard from a few streets away across a quiet snowy city at night, long resonant decay, no other bells, no music

clock-strike.text: A single strike of a large old tower clock bell, heard from inside the building through walls, deep and slightly muffled, resonant decay, no ticking, no music

rumble.text: A short deep rumble and shudder running through an old building as a heavy hidden mechanism releases, wood and stone, no music

shelf-opens.text: A heavy wooden bookshelf swinging open like a hidden door, slow deep wooden creak ending in a soft thud, interior, no music

paper.text: An old sheet of letter paper being unfolded and handled, soft dry rustle, close, no music, no voices

sniff.text: A large dog sniffing curiously, a few short sniffs and a soft snort, close microphone, no barking, no music

revolving-door.text: A heavy brass and glass hotel revolving door turning slowly, soft swoosh and brush seals, interior, no music, no voices

lobby.text: Room tone of a grand old hotel lobby late in the evening, very quiet, a slow ticking clock far away, soft air, no music, no voices

blizzard.text: A heavy snowstorm heard from inside a large building, wind pressing against tall old windows, soft gusts, steady, no music, no voices

dog-shake.text: A large wet dog shaking itself off vigorously, flapping ears and a jingling collar tag, indoors, no barking, no music

key-counter.text: A heavy brass object being set down on a polished wooden counter, one solid metallic clack, close, no music, no voices

globe-shimmer.text: A delicate glassy shimmer like tiny glass chimes and fine snow swirling inside a glass globe, soft, magical, gentle, short

drawer.text: An old wooden desk drawer being pulled open, small objects shifting inside, close, no music, no voices

lamp-click.text: A small flashlight switch clicking on once, close, dry, no music, no voices

fireplace.text: A wood fire crackling quietly in an open fireplace in a panelled room, steady, close, no music, no voices

running-steps.text: Light quick footsteps of a young woman running out of a room across a wooden floor, fading away, then a door swinging shut, no music, no voices

phone-ring.text: An old mechanical bell telephone ringing twice in the next room of a quiet building, slightly muffled, no music, no voices

safe-close.text: The heavy steel door of an old safe being pushed shut with a deep metallic clunk, close, no music, no voices

floor-creak.text: An old wooden floorboard creaking slowly under a single careful step, close, no music, no voices

pearls.text: A few pearls dropping onto wooden stairs one after another and rolling a short way, small bright taps, close, no music, no voices

cup.text: A porcelain coffee cup being set down gently on its saucer, close, no music, no voices

book-thud.text: A very heavy old leather-bound book being set down on a wooden table, a single dull thud, close, no music, no voices

drip.text: Water dripping slowly onto stone in a large, silent, dark hall at night, sparse single drops with a faint echo, no music, no voices

steps-door-slam.text: Quick heavy footsteps hurrying across old wooden floorboards overhead, then a door slamming shut somewhere above, muffled through the ceiling, no music, no voices

crate.text: The lid of a small wooden crate being lifted, wood creak and the dry rustle of wood wool packing, close, no music, no voices

envelope-slide.text: A paper envelope being pushed under a door and sliding across a wooden floor, short, close, no music, no voices

page-turn.text: A single thick page of an old ledger being turned slowly, close, no music, no voices

furnace.text: A small glassblowing workshop, the steady low roar of a furnace, warm and enclosed, no music, no voices

hall-hush.text: Room tone of a vast baroque library hall, almost silent, huge reverberant space, a faint distant footstep now and then, no music, no voices

market.text: An outdoor Christmas market at night in a city square, a quiet crowd murmur, distant laughter, cups clinking, footsteps on snow, no music, no distinct words

crows.text: A few crows cawing in a quiet snowy cemetery on a winter afternoon, sparse, distant, no music, no voices

distant-bell.text: A single small church bell ringing slowly a few times far away behind a wall on a quiet winter afternoon, no music, no voices

cafe.text: A quiet old Viennese coffee house in the afternoon, soft murmur of a few guests, cups and spoons, no music, no distinct words

lights-on.text: Old electric lights flickering back on after a power cut, a brief electrical hum and a few soft ticks, interior, no music, no voices

sledging.text: Children sledging and laughing in a snowy park in the distance on a winter afternoon, open air, faint, no music, no distinct words

dog-bark.text: A single loud deep bark of a large dog indoors, one bark only, short room echo, no music

click.text: A small precise metallic click of a hidden spring mechanism releasing, close, dry, no music, no voices

metal-groan.text: A huge old iron and brass clock mechanism jolting awake after years, one heavy jolt and a long low groan of metal, no ticking, no music, no voices

gears.text: Large heavy brass gears of a tower clock slowly starting to turn, deep grinding and rolling, no music, no voices

lock-rings.text: The small brass number rings of an old combination padlock being turned, a few soft ratcheting clicks, close, no music, no voices

pen-writing.text: A fountain pen writing steadily on thick paper, soft scratching strokes, close, no music, no voices

emboss.text: A hand-held embossing press being squeezed onto thick paper, a firm crunch and release, close, no music, no voices
